description: This file is a test module for verifying the creation and configuration of application settings related to CORS in a FastAPI project. It tests handling of empty or invalid environment variables influencing the CORS configuration, and ensures that the Settings object properly handles these cases without errors.

methods.name: temp_env(env: dict)
methods.description: Context manager that temporarily overrides environment variables for testing purposes, and clears cached settings.

methods.name: test_settings_creation_with_empty_allowed_origins()
methods.description: Test function that runs multiple scenarios with different environment variable setups to verify that the Settings object handles empty or whitespace values for CORS configuration without errors.
